sections.title: Theft
sections.gist: Dishonestly taking movable property out of another's possession without consent.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Snatching
sections.gist: Theft committed by sudden or forcible seizure before the victim can resist.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

sections.title: Theft in a dwelling house or means of transport
sections.gist: Theft in a building, tent, vessel, or means of transport used as human dwelling.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Criminal breach of trust
sections.gist: Dishonest misappropriation of property entrusted to a person.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years (up to 10 years for public servant/agent), and fine.

sections.title: Cheating
sections.gist: Deceiving a person to deliver property or do/omit an act causing damage.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years (up to 7 years if property/valuable security involved), and fine.

sections.title: Cheating by personation
sections.gist: Cheating by pretending to be another person or a fictitious person.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Mischief
sections.gist: Causing wrongful loss or damage to property with intent or knowledge.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year (higher for fire/explosives/animals), or fine, or both.

sections.title: House-trespass / house-breaking
sections.gist: Entering or unlawfully remaining in a dwelling with intent to commit an offence.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years and fine (higher for house-breaking).

sections.title: Criminal intimidation
sections.gist: Threatening a person with injury to induce fear or compel an act/omission.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both (up to 7 years for grave threats).

sections.title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
sections.gist: Insulting a person intending to provoke breach of public peace.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Defamation
sections.gist: Making or publishing an imputation harming a person's reputation.
sections.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
sections.gist: Causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to another intentionally.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
sections.gist: Causing hurt amounting to grievous injury as defined under the Act.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Hurt/grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
sections.gist: Causing hurt using a weapon, fire, poison or other dangerous means.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine (up to life for grievous hurt).

sections.title: Wrongful restraint
sections.gist: Obstructing a person from proceeding in a direction they have a right to.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both.

sections.title: Wrongful confinement
sections.gist: Wrongfully preventing a person from proceeding beyond certain limits.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both (higher for longer confinement).

sections.title: Assault
sections.gist: Gesture or preparation causing apprehension of criminal force.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both.

sections.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
sections.gist: Assault/use of criminal force intending to outrage a woman's modesty.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 1 to 5 years and fine.

sections.title: Sexual harassment
sections.gist: Physical contact/demand for sexual favour, showing pornography, or sexually coloured remarks.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Assault/use of criminal force to disrobe a woman
sections.gist: Act intending to disrobe or compel nakedness of a woman.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 3 to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Voyeurism
sections.gist: Watching or capturing image of a woman engaged in a private act without consent.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 1 to 3 years (up to 7 years on repeat), and fine.

sections.title: Stalking
sections.gist: Following, contacting or monitoring a woman despite disinterest, including cyber-stalking.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years (up to 5 years on repeat), and fine.

sections.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman
sections.gist: Insulting the modesty of a woman by word, gesture, act or intrusion of privacy.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

sections.title: Dowry death
sections.gist: Death of a woman within 7 years of marriage caused by dowry-related cruelty/harassment.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment not less than 7 years, extendable to life.

sections.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
sections.gist: Subjecting a woman to cruelty by husband or his relatives.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

sections.title: Cruelty defined
sections.gist: Defines cruelty: wilful conduct likely to drive to suicide/grave injury, or harassment for dowry.
sections.punishment: Refer to section 85 for punishment.

sections.title: Kidnapping
sections.gist: Kidnapping from India or from lawful guardianship.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Kidnapping or abduction for ransom etc.
sections.gist: Kidnapping/abducting to compel payment of ransom or for other unlawful compulsion.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 10 years to life, and fine; death/life for hurt caused.

sections.title: Trafficking of person
sections.gist: Recruiting, transporting, harbouring or receiving a person by force/fraud for exploitation.
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment 7 to 10 years and fine (higher for minors/repeat).

sections.title: Unlawful assembly
sections.gist: Assembly of 5 or more persons with a common unlawful object.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Rioting
sections.gist: Force or violence used by an unlawful assembly or its members.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both (higher with deadly weapon).

sections.title: Promoting enmity between groups
sections.gist: Acts prejudicial to harmony on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, language etc.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Public nuisance
sections.gist: Act causing common injury, danger or annoyance to the public.
sections.punishment: Fine up to Rs 1,000.

sections.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
sections.gist: Driving/riding so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both.

sections.title: Causing death by negligence
sections.gist: Causing death by a rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine (higher for hit-and-run by registered driver).

sections.title: Extortion
sections.gist: Putting a person in fear of injury to dishonestly induce delivery of property.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Robbery
sections.gist: Theft or extortion aggravated by force or fear causing hurt/wrongful restraint.
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

sections.title: Dacoity
sections.gist: Robbery committed by five or more persons acting in concert.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

sections.title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
sections.gist: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting movable property to one's own use.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Receiving stolen property
sections.gist: Dishonestly receiving or retaining property known to be stolen.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both (up to 5 years for habitual dealing).

sections.title: Forgery
sections.gist: Making a false document/electronic record with intent to cause damage or support a claim.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both (up to 7 years for specified purposes).

sections.title: Forgery of a valuable security, will, etc.
sections.gist: Forgery of a valuable security, will, or authority to adopt/make/transfer property.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

sections.title: Using as genuine a forged document
sections.gist: Fraudulently or dishonestly using a document known to be forged.
sections.punishment: Same punishment as for forgery of that document.

sections.title: Criminal conspiracy
sections.gist: Agreement between two or more persons to do or cause to be done an illegal act.
sections.punishment: Punishable as if abetted, per the object of the conspiracy.

sections.title: Attempt to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment
sections.gist: Attempting an offence and doing an act towards its commission.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to one-half of the longest term provided, or as specified, and/or fine.

sections.title: Common intention
sections.gist: Act done by several persons in furtherance of common intention treated as done by each.
sections.punishment: Each liable as if the act were done by them alone.

sections.title: Criminal intimidation by anonymous communication
sections.gist: Intimidation by an anonymous or unsigned communication, or after taking precautions to conceal identity.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, in addition to the term for the intimidation.

sections.title: Criminal intimidation with threat of death/grievous hurt etc.
sections.gist: Aggravated criminal intimidation: threat of death, grievous hurt, destruction by fire, or imputation affecting chastity.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Organised crime
sections.gist: Continuing unlawful activity by a crime syndicate using violence, threat, or corruption for material benefit.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 5 years to life, and fine not less than Rs 5 lakh (death/life if death results).

sections.title: Petty organised crime
sections.gist: Theft, snatching, cheating, unauthorised ticketing/gambling etc. by a group/gang.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment 1 to 7 years and fine.

sections.title: Acts endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
sections.gist: Exciting secession, armed rebellion, subversive activities, or endangering sovereignty/unity of India.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or up to 7 years, and fine.

sections.title: Statements conducing to public mischief
sections.gist: Making/publishing statements likely to cause fear, alarm, or incite an offence against the State/public tranquility.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both (higher for religion/race/community).

sections.title: Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings
sections.gist: Deliberate and malicious acts/words intended to outrage religious feelings by insulting religion or beliefs.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Obscene acts and songs
sections.gist: Doing an obscene act in a public place, or singing obscene songs causing annoyance.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine, or both.

sections.title: Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant
sections.gist: Knowingly disobeying a lawful order/direction issued by a public servant.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 2,500, or both (higher if it causes danger).

sections.title: Information in cognizable cases (FIR)
sections.gist: Police officer must register FIR on information of a cognizable offence; preliminary enquiry allowed in limited cases (3-7 yr punishment) before registration.
sections.punishment: Procedural — governs registration of FIR.

sections.title: Refusal to register FIR - remedy
sections.gist: If officer-in-charge refuses to record information, complainant may send the substance in writing by post to the Superintendent of Police.
sections.punishment: Procedural — SP must then investigate or direct investigation.

sections.title: Magistrate's power to order police investigation
sections.gist: Magistrate may order an investigation under this section, or himself investigate/direct inquiry, on a complaint of a cognizable offence.
sections.punishment: Procedural — precedes cognizance.

sections.title: Arrest without warrant by police
sections.gist: Conditions under which police may arrest without a warrant, including safeguards for offences punishable up to 3 years.
sections.punishment: Procedural — governs arrest.

sections.title: Maximum period for which undertrial prisoner can be detained
sections.gist: First-time offenders (not facing death/life sentence) to be released on bond after undergoing one-third of the maximum sentence for the offence; undertrials generally after half.
sections.punishment: Procedural — bail/release entitlement.

sections.title: Zero FIR
sections.gist: FIR can be registered at any police station irrespective of the area where the offence occurred (zero FIR), later transferred to the jurisdictional station.
sections.punishment: Procedural — no territorial refusal permitted for cognizable offence.

sections.title: Identity theft
sections.gist: Fraudulently or dishonestly using another person's electronic signature, password or unique identification feature.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs 1 lakh.

sections.title: Cheating by personation using computer resource
sections.gist: Cheating by personation by means of any communication device or computer resource.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs 1 lakh.

sections.title: Violation of privacy
sections.gist: Intentionally capturing, publishing or transmitting the image of a private area of a person without consent.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine up to Rs 2 lakh, or both.

sections.title: Publishing obscene material in electronic form
sections.gist: Publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form.
sections.punishment: First conviction up to 3 years and fine up to Rs 5 lakh (higher on subsequent conviction).
